docs.name: note-001.txt
docs.text: Mix two cups of flour with baking powder, a pinch of salt, milk and a beaten egg. Fry the batter in butter until golden and serve with maple syrup.

docs.name: note-002.txt
docs.text: Layer pasta sheets with minced beef ragu, bechamel and mozzarella. Bake for forty minutes at 180 degrees until the top is bubbling.

docs.name: note-003.txt
docs.text: Flight to Lisbon departs at dawn on the ninth. Hotel booked near the harbour, tram pass needed for the old hills.

docs.name: note-004.txt
docs.text: Rail pass valid for two weeks, reserve the bullet train seats early. Stay in Shinjuku and visit the temples in Asakusa.

docs.name: note-005.txt
docs.text: The bank approved refinancing at a lower interest rate. Monthly repayment drops by about two hundred, closing fees due in spring.

docs.name: note-006.txt
docs.text: Deadline for filing the annual return is the end of April. Gather receipts for charitable donations and the home office deduction.

docs.name: note-007.txt
docs.text: Appointment with the dentist on Thursday morning for a cavity filling. Avoid eating for two hours afterwards.

docs.name: note-008.txt
docs.text: Fever and a sore throat for three days. Doctor recommended rest, plenty of fluids and paracetamol every six hours.

docs.name: note-009.txt
docs.text: Monday chest and triceps, Wednesday back and biceps, Friday legs. Increase the barbell weight by two kilos each fortnight.

docs.name: note-010.txt
docs.text: Long run of thirty kilometres on Sunday, easy jog on Tuesday. Race day pacing target is five minutes twenty per kilometre.

docs.name: note-011.txt
docs.text: Kitchen faucet drips constantly. Replace the rubber washer and tighten the cartridge nut, shut off the water valve first.

docs.name: note-012.txt
docs.text: Living room walls need two coats of pale grey emulsion. Sand the cracks, tape the skirting boards and cover the floor.

docs.name: note-013.txt
docs.text: Water the tomato seedlings every morning and feed with liquid fertiliser weekly. Pinch out side shoots to boost the fruit.

docs.name: note-014.txt
docs.text: The kitten needs vaccination and deworming next month. Feed small portions of wet food twice a day.

docs.name: note-015.txt
docs.text: Take the retriever to the park before breakfast, bring the ball and a leash. He gets anxious around thunder.

docs.name: note-016.txt
docs.text: Script parses the CSV export, drops duplicate rows and writes a cleaned spreadsheet. Uses pandas and runs nightly via scheduler.

docs.name: note-017.txt
docs.text: Move the customer tables to the new Postgres cluster during the weekend maintenance window. Take a full backup and verify row counts afterwards.

docs.name: note-018.txt
docs.text: Website was unreachable for forty minutes because the load balancer certificate expired. Add monitoring alerts to renew certificates automatically.

docs.name: note-019.txt
docs.text: Staff must use passphrases of at least fourteen characters and enable two factor authentication. Reuse across services is forbidden.

docs.name: note-020.txt
docs.text: Router admin page at the gateway address. Change the default network name, choose WPA3 and move the smart bulbs to the guest network.

docs.name: note-021.txt
docs.text: Team agreed to postpone the product launch campaign by one month. Social media budget cut, focus on newsletter subscribers.

docs.name: note-022.txt
docs.text: Prepare examples of leading a team through a difficult deadline. Ask about career growth and the onboarding process.

docs.name: note-023.txt
docs.text: Experienced analyst with eight years in logistics, skilled in forecasting and supplier negotiations. Seeking a senior planning role.

docs.name: note-024.txt
docs.text: Entropy always increases in an isolated system. The second law explains why heat flows from hot objects to cold ones.

docs.name: note-025.txt
docs.text: The printing press spread across Europe in the fifteenth century, accelerating literacy and the exchange of scientific ideas.

docs.name: note-026.txt
docs.text: Rising sea levels threaten coastal cities. Reducing carbon emissions and restoring wetlands are the main mitigation strategies.

docs.name: note-027.txt
docs.text: Solve the quadratic equation by completing the square. Then find the derivative of the function and its critical points.

docs.name: note-028.txt
docs.text: A novel about a lighthouse keeper who slowly loses his memory; the sea is a metaphor for forgetting. Slow but moving ending.

docs.name: note-029.txt
docs.text: Weekend watchlist: a space survival thriller, a silent-era comedy and the animated film about a girl and a river spirit.

docs.name: note-030.txt
docs.text: Practice scales on the piano for twenty minutes, then the left hand of the waltz slowly with a metronome at sixty beats.

docs.name: note-031.txt
docs.text: Surprise party for Maya on Saturday at seven. Order a chocolate cake, hide the balloons and invite her college friends.

docs.name: note-032.txt
docs.text: Ceremony in the garden at four, reception in the barn. Final headcount is due to the caterer two weeks before.

docs.name: note-033.txt
docs.text: Car is due for an oil change and new brake pads. Tyre pressure low on the rear left, book the garage for Friday.

docs.name: note-034.txt
docs.text: Home insurance renewal arrives in June. Compare quotes, check that jewellery and the laptop are covered against theft.

docs.name: note-035.txt
docs.text: Tenancy agreement lasts twelve months with a month of notice. Security deposit is refundable if no damage is found at move-out.

docs.name: note-036.txt
docs.text: Pack books in small boxes, label by room, forward the mail and cancel the internet at the old flat.

docs.name: note-037.txt
docs.text: Oats, bananas, spinach, olive oil, yoghurt and two lemons. Do not forget coffee beans and dish soap.

docs.name: note-038.txt
docs.text: Monthly spending: rent is half of the income, groceries next, then transport. Aim to save fifteen percent every payday.

docs.name: note-039.txt
docs.text: Diversify across index funds and avoid concentrating in a single stock. Rebalance the portfolio once a year.

docs.name: note-040.txt
docs.text: App that matches volunteers with local food banks based on free evenings. Needs a simple map and a push notification when shifts open.

docs.name: note-041.txt
docs.text: Customer received a damaged parcel and demands a refund. Offer a replacement and apologise, escalate if they refuse.

docs.name: note-042.txt
docs.text: Fall asleep faster by dimming screens an hour before bed, keeping the bedroom cool and avoiding caffeine after lunch.

docs.name: note-043.txt
docs.text: Sit quietly and follow the breath for ten minutes. When thoughts wander, gently return attention to the inhale and exhale.

docs.name: note-044.txt
docs.text: Trail climbs steeply to the ridge; carry two litres of water, a rain jacket and sturdy boots. Start before sunrise to avoid the heat.

docs.name: note-045.txt
docs.text: Tent, sleeping bag, stove, headlamp and a first aid kit. Check the weather and pack food in a sealed bag against bears.

docs.name: note-046.txt
docs.text: Shoot portraits at golden hour with a wide aperture for blurred backgrounds. Edit the raw files to adjust exposure and white balance.

docs.name: note-047.txt
docs.text: Grind the beans coarsely, steep in hot water for four minutes in the press, then push the plunger slowly.

docs.name: note-048.txt
docs.text: Control the centre early, develop knights before bishops and castle to protect the king. Avoid moving the same piece twice in the opening.
